text:
emma: Spot check from today's bring-up: rnk-v4-ptq shows neutral NDCG but top-1 MRR down ~3.8% on short procedural docs.
raji: Any short repro?
emma: Tiny example from holdout:
```
query: \"enable gzip on nginx\"\ndoc_good: \"Edit /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.\nAdd gzip on;\nReload service.\" -> rank 1 (fp16)
doc_bad: \"Enable gzip by editing nginx.conf. Then run: `systemctl reload nginx`\" -> drops to rank 3 (ptq)
```
tom: Hmm, the inline backtick may be tokenizing differently. Did we export the tokenizer with the quantized artifact?
emma: Token counts: fp16 doc_bad tokens 34, ptq doc_bad tokens 31. Token strings near backtick: fp16 ['`', 'systemctl', 'reload', 'nginx', '`'] vs ptq ['`systemctl', 'reloadnginx`']
dmitri: That merge screams tokenizer-binary mismatch. Quick check: run tokenizer-diff on packaging step and on eval runner.
ci-bot: queued job 5178901234-tdiff: ./tools/tokenizer_diff --model rnk-v4-ptq --sample 500 --output /tmp/tdiff-5178901234
tom: Also try a per-head calib experiment. Last PTQ run was per-tensor; head variance might be large for punctuation-heavy tokens.
raji: Agreed. Two quick experiments: (1) tokenizer parity + normalization (insert spaces around inline code and backticks), (2) per-head calibration sweep on 2k docs.
ci-bot: queued job 5178901234-exp1: ./eval --model rnk-v4-ptq --slice short-procedural --preproc normalize_code_spaces --samples 1000
ci-bot: queued job 5178901234-exp2: ./quant --model rnk-v4 --calib per_head --samples 2000 --save-weights /artifacts/5178901234
emma: If exp1 recovers most of the MRR, we can add a lightweight preproc normalization in onboarding while infra fixes tokenizer parity.
dmitri: I'll PR a small check into the packaging pipeline: compute a sha of tokenizer config and fail if mismatch between exporter and runtime.
tom: Also add a regression-golden-slice of 600 items focusing on inline code, bullets, and short sentence breaks. CI should assert top1 MRR delta <= 1.5% vs fp16.
raji: Good plan. Who picks the golden set?
emma: I'll curate it and open a PR with metadata + a small runner job. Tagging @dmitri and @tom for review.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: job 5178901234-tdiff completed. Found 37 mismatches where tokenizer binary differed. Report: https://redwood.internal/tdiff/5178901234
dmitri: Nice. I'll start the packaging parity fix. Once that's in, we should re-run baseline to confirm.
emma: Thanks team. Closing after PRs merge and one clean rerun.
